step1_analysis.description: A PMOS-input differential amplifier with an NMOS current mirror load and a subthreshold-biased tail current source. It is designed for ultralow-power applications, likely serving as an error amplifier in the reference current generator discussed in the paper.

paper_reference.title: An Evaluation of MOS Interface-Trap Charge Pump as an Ultralow Constant-Current Generator

sky130_expected.calculation: gm = Id/(n*Vt) ≈ 640nS. Rout = 1/(2*lambda*Id) ≈ 200MΩ. Gain = gm*Rout ≈ 128 V/V = 42 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Subthreshold operation yields high intrinsic gain but is highly dependent on the Early voltage (lambda) of the specific process.
Matches the 100 kHz reported in the paper, assuming a standard 1pF load capacitance.

phase_margin.description: Phase margin at unity gain frequency

sky130_expected.calculation: Single-stage OTA with 1pF load typically has >60 degrees phase margin.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The dominant pole is at the output, while non-dominant poles at the current mirror are at much higher frequencies.
Ultralow current design operates in subthreshold, leading to nanowatt-range power consumption.

slew_rate.description: Maximum rate of change of the output voltage

sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited by the ultralow tail current charging the load capacitor.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for measuring DC gain, UGF, phase margin, power, and slew rate of the ultralow-power OTA. It uses a large RC filter to close the loop for DC biasing while keeping it open for AC analysis, and then alters the components to configure a unity-gain buffer for transient step response.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Ultralow-Power OTA Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u

XM1 N0 VI1 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 VO N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 VO VI2 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N2 VB N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 VDD VG1 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 VDD VG2 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVB VB 0 0.99
VVG1 VG1 0 1.8
VVG2 VG2 0 1.8

* Input source: DC bias, AC signal, and Transient step
VIN VI1 0 dc 0.9 ac 1 pulse(0.8 1.0 10u 10n 10n 500u 1m)

* Feedback network: Acts as open-loop for AC, closed-loop for DC
R1 VO VI2 1G
C1 VI2 0 1
CL VO 0 1p

.control
* 1. Operating Point & Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* 2. AC Analysis (Open Loop)
ac dec 10 1 100Meg
let gain_db = vdb(VO)
let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(VO))
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1
meas ac ugf when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac pm find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1

* Reconfigure feedback network for Transient Analysis (Unity Gain Buffer)
alter r1 1m
alter c1 1p

* 3. Transient Analysis (Step Response)
tran 100n 1m
meas tran t_rise trig v(VO) val=0.82 rise=1 targ v(VO) val=0.98 rise=1
meas tran t_fall trig v(VO) val=0.98 fall=1 targ v(VO) val=0.82 fall=1

quit
.endc
.end
